1|"""Daily money budget and warm-up throttle (pure part of verifier S4).
2|
3|Cost per build = model GPU seconds x GPU_USD_PER_S + SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD,
4|plus the idle tail after the last build of a burst (IDLE_TAIL_USD, charged
5|once per burst: a build that starts a new burst -- no build in the last
6|BURST_GAP_S -- carries it) and WAKE_USD each time a warm-up is actually
7|fired. Warm-ups are throttled: at most one per 10 minutes globally and one
8|per hour per IP. Spend is kept keyed by UTC date; at or over the cap the
9|API reports paused and refuses builds.
10|
11|Warmth is learned WITHOUT any request to the model (verifier W2): the last
12|real model response sets ``warm_until`` = response time + SCALE_DOWN_S
13|(the 300 s scale-down). A build that starts while not warm is a cold start
14|and is charged WAKE_USD once. The web layer may additionally treat a
15|positive container count (Modal ``get_current_stats``, best effort) as warm.
16|
17|Tests drive this with a fake clock; ``deploy/modal_web.py`` mirrors the
18|numbers into a Modal Dict for persistence across restarts. The web layer
19|calls mutating methods from a worker thread, so they are lock-guarded.
20|"""
21|
22|import datetime
23|import threading
24|import time
25|
26|from . import config
27|
28|
29|def day_key(now=None):
30|    """UTC date string for today's spend bucket."""
31|    t = time.time() if now is None else now
32|    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(
33|        t, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
34|
35|
36|class Budget:
37|    """Spend ledger + warm-up throttle (one web process)."""
38|
39|    def __init__(self, now=None):
40|        self._now = now or time.time
41|        self._mu = threading.Lock()
42|        self._spend = {}  # day_key -> dollars
43|        self._last_build = None  # unix seconds of the last charged build
44|        self._last_warmup = None  # unix seconds of the last fired warm-up
45|        self._ip_warmups = {}  # ip -> unix seconds of its last warm-up
46|        self._warm_until = None  # wall seconds; warm while now < this
47|
48|    # -- spend ---------------------------------------------------------
49|    def spent_today(self):
50|        """Dollars charged in the current UTC day."""
51|        with self._mu:
52|            return self._spend.get(day_key(self._now()), 0.0)
53|
54|    def is_capped(self):
55|        """True once today's spend is at or over the daily cap."""
56|        return self.spent_today() >= config.DAILY_CAP_USD
57|
58|    def _add(self, dollars):
59|        key = day_key(self._now())
60|        self._spend[key] = self._spend.get(key, 0.0) + dollars
61|        return dollars
62|
63|    def charge_build(self, gpu_seconds):
64|        """Charge one build; returns the dollars added.
65|
66|        GPU seconds plus one sandbox fee, plus one idle tail when this
67|        build starts a new burst.
68|        """
69|        with self._mu:
70|            t = self._now()
71|            try:
72|                gpu = float(gpu_seconds or 0.0)
73|            except (TypeError, ValueError):
74|                gpu = 0.0
75|            cost = gpu * config.GPU_USD_PER_S + config.SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD
76|            if self._last_build is None or \
77|                    t - self._last_build > config.BURST_GAP_S:
78|                cost += config.IDLE_TAIL_USD  # one tail per burst
79|            self._last_build = t
80|            return self._add(cost)
81|
82|    # -- warmth (no model request; verifier W2) ------------------------
83|    def is_warm(self):
84|        """True while the model is known warm from a recent response."""
85|        with self._mu:
86|            return self._warm_until is not None and \
87|                self._now() < self._warm_until
88|
89|    def note_model_response(self):
90|        """Record a real model response: warm for one scale-down window."""
91|        with self._mu:
92|            self._warm_until = self._now() + config.SCALE_DOWN_S
93|
94|    def note_cold_build(self):
95|        """Charge WAKE_USD once for a build that starts while not warm."""
96|        with self._mu:
97|            return self._add(config.WAKE_USD)
98|
99|    # -- warm-ups ------------------------------------------------------
100|    def may_warmup(self, ip):
101|        """True when a warm-up for this IP may fire now (throttled)."""
102|        with self._mu:
103|            t = self._now()
104|            if self._last_warmup is not None and \
105|                    t - self._last_warmup < config.WARMUP_GLOBAL_S:
106|                return False
107|            last = self._ip_warmups.get(ip)
108|            if last is not None and t - last < config.WARMUP_IP_S:
109|                return False
110|            return True
111|
112|    def note_warmup(self, ip):
113|        """Record an actually-fired warm-up and charge WAKE_USD."""
114|        with self._mu:
115|            t = self._now()
116|            self._last_warmup = t
117|            self._ip_warmups[ip] = t
118|            return self._add(config.WAKE_USD)
119|
120|    # -- status --------------------------------------------------------
121|    def warm_status(self, container_warm=False):
122|        """(state, message) with NO side effects and NO model request.
123|
124|        Ready when a recent real response (or a positive container count
125|        learned without sending an input) says the model is up; otherwise
126|        waking. The caller decides (via may_warmup/note_warmup) whether to
127|        actually fire a throttled warm-up request.
128|        """
129|        if self.is_capped():
130|            return "paused", config.PAUSED_MESSAGE
131|        if self.is_warm() or container_warm:
132|            return "ready", "The model is ready"
133|        return ("waking",
134|                "Waking up the model (this takes a few minutes). "
135|                "Here is a recorded run meanwhile.")
136|
137|    def status(self, probe_ok):
138|        """(state, message) with NO side effects.
139|
140|        Kept for compatibility: a truthy probe is treated like a warm
141|        signal. The web layer no longer probes; it uses warm_status().
142|        """
143|        return self.warm_status(container_warm=bool(probe_ok))

1|"""Visitor protection limits (pure part of verifier S3).
2|
3|The Modal web function keeps ONE process (``max_containers=1``) and holds
4|these counters in that process behind an asyncio lock (Modal Dict has no
5|atomic counter; the Dict is only persistence across restarts). This module
6|holds the pure rules so tests can drive them with a fake clock; the lock
7|itself lives in ``deploy/modal_web.py``.
8|"""
9|
10|import threading
11|import time
12|import uuid
13|
14|from . import config
15|
16|
17|def new_run_id():
18|    """A run id: 32 hex chars (uuid4)."""
19|    return uuid.uuid4().hex
20|
21|
22|def client_ip(x_forwarded_for, peer):
23|    """The client IP for limits.
24|
25|    Takes the LAST hop added by Modal's proxy, never the first
26|    X-Forwarded-For entry (which a visitor can spoof). Falls back to the
27|    connection peer when no forwarding header is present.

1|"""Daily money budget and warm-up throttle (pure part of verifier S4).
2|
3|Cost per build = model GPU seconds x GPU_USD_PER_S + SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD,
4|plus the idle tail after the last build of a burst (IDLE_TAIL_USD, charged
5|once per burst: a build that starts a new burst -- no build in the last
6|BURST_GAP_S -- carries it) and WAKE_USD each time a warm-up is actually
7|fired. Warm-ups are throttled: at most one per 10 minutes globally and one
8|per hour per IP. Spend is kept keyed by UTC date; at or over the cap the
9|API reports paused and refuses builds.
10|
11|Warmth is learned WITHOUT any request to the model (verifier W2): the last
12|real model response sets ``warm_until`` = response time + SCALE_DOWN_S
13|(the 300 s scale-down). A build that starts while not warm is a cold start
14|and is charged WAKE_USD once. The web layer may additionally treat a
15|positive container count (Modal ``get_current_stats``, best effort) as warm.
16|
17|Tests drive this with a fake clock; ``deploy/modal_web.py`` mirrors the
18|numbers into a Modal Dict for persistence across restarts. The web layer
19|calls mutating methods from a worker thread, so they are lock-guarded.
20|"""

24|import time

29|def day_key(now=None):

31|    t = time.time() if now is None else now
32|    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(

36|class Budget:
37|    """Spend ledger + warm-up throttle (one web process)."""
38|
39|    def __init__(self, now=None):
40|        self._now = now or time.time
41|        self._mu = threading.Lock()
42|        self._spend = {}  # day_key -> dollars
43|        self._last_build = None  # unix seconds of the last charged build
44|        self._last_warmup = None  # unix seconds of the last fired warm-up
45|        self._ip_warmups = {}  # ip -> unix seconds of its last warm-up
46|        self._warm_until = None  # wall seconds; warm while now < this
47|
48|    # -- spend ---------------------------------------------------------
49|    def spent_today(self):
50|        """Dollars charged in the current UTC day."""
51|        with self._mu:
52|            return self._spend.get(day_key(self._now()), 0.0)
53|
54|    def is_capped(self):
55|        """True once today's spend is at or over the daily cap."""
56|        return self.spent_today() >= config.DAILY_CAP_USD
57|
58|    def _add(self, dollars):
59|        key = day_key(self._now())
60|        self._spend[key] = self._spend.get(key, 0.0) + dollars
61|        return dollars

63|    def charge_build(self, gpu_seconds):
64|        """Charge one build; returns the dollars added.
65|
66|        GPU seconds plus one sandbox fee, plus one idle tail when this
67|        build starts a new burst.
68|        """
69|        with self._mu:
70|            t = self._now()
71|            try:
72|                gpu = float(gpu_seconds or 0.0)
73|            except (TypeError, ValueError):
74|                gpu = 0.0
75|            cost = gpu * config.GPU_USD_PER_S + config.SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD
76|            if self._last_build is None or \
77|                    t - self._last_build > config.BURST_GAP_S:
78|                cost += config.IDLE_TAIL_USD  # one tail per burst
79|            self._last_build = t
80|            return self._add(cost)

89|            clock=None, deadline=None):
90|    """Yield SSE-style event dicts for one visitor job.
91|
92|    Event steps: write, build, fix, measure, done (or error). The first
93|    event is yielded before the first model call. The final done event
94|    carries verdict/reasons/measurements/code/rounds/seconds/gpu_seconds;
95|    the web layer adds the file URLs.

98|    whole build (verifier W4): no new model call and no new box run starts
99|    once it has passed. The caller also sizes each model call's own timeout
100|    from the time left until the deadline.
101|    """
102|    now = clock or time.monotonic
103|    t0 = now()
104|    messages = initial_messages(job_text)
105|    best_code = ""
106|    best_raw = None
107|    last_error = None
108|    gpu_total = 0.0
109|    rounds = 0
110|    while rounds < MAX_CALLS:

112|        yield {"step": "write", "round": rounds,
113|               "detail": "Writing the part script (round %d of %d)."
114|                         % (rounds, MAX_CALLS)}
115|        if _past_deadline(now, deadline):
116|            break

118|        try:
119|            content, gpu_s = model_call(messages, body)
120|        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 -- failed call ends the loop
121|            if best_raw is None and not best_code:
122|                last_error = "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)
123|            break

126|        except (TypeError, ValueError):

129|        if not has_code(content):

131|                last_error = "the model sent no code"
132|            break
133|        code = runner.extract_code(content)
134|        if _past_deadline(now, deadline):
135|            break
136|        try:
137|            boxed = box_run(code)
138|        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 -- harness error is a crash
139|            boxed = {"brep_bytes": None, "measure": None,
140|                     "run_error": "runner error: %r" % (e,)}
141|        if boxed is None or boxed.get("brep_bytes") is None:
142|            err = (boxed or {}).get("run_error") or \
143|                "the answer wrote no BREP"
144|            last_error = err
145|            yield {"step": "build", "round": rounds,
146|                   "detail": "Building in the locked box."}
147|            yield {"step": "fix", "round": rounds,
148|                   "detail": _cap(err)}
149|            messages.append({"role": "user",
150|                             "content": runner.bx_error_message(err)})
151|            continue
152|        measure_raw = boxed.get("measure")
153|        measure = runner_final.box_measure_to_selfcheck(measure_raw)
154|        yield {"step": "build", "round": rounds,
155|               "detail": "Building in the locked box."}
156|        best_code = code
157|        best_raw = measure_raw
158|        last_error = None
159|        if measure is None:
160|            break
161|        yield {"step": "measure", "round": rounds,
162|               "detail": _measure_line(measure),
163|               "measurements": measure_raw}
164|        # FTX rule (Claude fix 2026-11-02, disclosed): after a build the
165|        # model sees its own measurements and either fixes the part or says
166|        # DONE (no code fence), up to MAX_CALLS. The last built part counts.
167|        messages.append({"role": "user",
168|                         "content": runner.bx_self_check_message(measure)})
169|        if rounds < MAX_CALLS:
170|            yield {"step": "fix", "round": rounds,
171|                   "detail": "Checking its own measurements."}
172|    seconds = now() - t0

175|    else:

177|                            [last_error or "the part did not build"])
178|    yield {"step": "done", "round": rounds, "verdict": verdict,
179|           "reason": "; ".join(reasons),

181|           "rounds": rounds, "seconds": round(seconds, 3),
